summary.text: Clifton Brown is an unaffiliated candidate for U.S. House in Colorado's 3rd District. Ballotpedia lists his profession as carpenter. In a Ballotpedia survey he says he will accept no corporate or PAC money and favors ending congressional districts.

paragraphs.text: Brown graduated from Cherry Creek High School and has worked as a carpenter, according to Ballotpedia.
In his 2026 Ballotpedia Candidate Connection survey, he states that he will not accept money from any corporation or PAC and will not earn more than his government salary.
